paragraphs.zh: gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe Halogen, Alkylthio und Alkyloxy substituiert sind, oder
paragraphs.en: optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of halogen, alkylthio and alkyloxy, or
paragraphs.notes: Continuation of a definition that begins on the previous printed page; the sentence has no subject on this page. No paragraph numbers are printed anywhere in this patent, so the marker is descriptive, not transcribed.

paragraphs.zh: zwei an einem gemeinsamen Kohlenstoffatom gebundene Reste R7 bilden eine Kette aus der Gruppe  OCH2CH2O, OCH2CH2CH2O, SCH2CH2S und SCH2CH2CH2S, wobei diese gegebenenfalls durch ein bis vier Methylgruppen substituiert ist, oder
paragraphs.en: two radicals R7 bonded to a common carbon atom form a chain from the group consisting of OCH2CH2O, OCH2CH2CH2O, SCH2CH2S and SCH2CH2CH2S, which is optionally substituted by one to four methyl groups, or
paragraphs.notes: The 7 of R7 is printed as a superscript and the 2 of each CH2/OCH2 as a subscript; both are transcribed inline here because the field is plain text. The double space before OCH2CH2O is as printed. A small ink speck sits directly above the superscript 7 of R7 on the first line; it is scanner dirt, not a character. The German verb agreement 'wobei diese ... substituiert ist' is as printed.

paragraphs.zh: zwei an direkt benachbarten Kohlenstoffatomen gebundene Reste R7 bilden eine Bindung oder bilden mit dem sie tragenden Kohlenstoffatomen einen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe Halogen, Alkyl,  Alkylthio und Alkoxy substituierten 3- bis 6-gliedrigen Ring;
paragraphs.en: two radicals R7 bonded to directly adjacent carbon atoms form a bond, or form together with the carbon atoms bearing them a 3- to 6-membered ring which is optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of halogen, alkyl, alkylthio and alkoxy;
paragraphs.notes: 'mit dem sie tragenden Kohlenstoffatomen' is as printed, with the case mismatch between 'dem' and 'Kohlenstoffatomen'. The double space after 'Alkyl,' is as printed.

paragraphs.zh: R12    Wasserstoff, Alkyl, Halogenalkyl, Alkoxyalkyl, Formyl, Alkylcarbonyl, Alkoxycarbonyl, Alkylaminocarbonyl, Dialkylaminocarbonyl, Alkylsulfonyl, Halogenalkylsulfonyl, Benzoyl oder Phenylsulfonyl, wobei die beiden letztgenannten Gruppen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe Alkyl, Halogenalkyl, Alkoxy, Halogenalkoxy, Halogen, Cyano und Nitro substituiert sind;
paragraphs.en: R12    hydrogen, alkyl, haloalkyl, alkoxyalkyl, formyl, alkylcarbonyl, alkoxycarbonyl, alkylaminocarbonyl, dialkylaminocarbonyl, alkylsulfonyl, haloalkylsulfonyl, benzoyl or phenylsulfonyl, where the two last-mentioned groups are optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of alkyl, haloalkyl, alkoxy, haloalkoxy, halogen, cyano and nitro;
paragraphs.notes: The 12 of R12 is printed as a superscript. The symbol sits in a left-hand definition column with the text indented from it; the run of spaces stands in for that column gap.

paragraphs.zh: L    eine gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste R2 substituierte C1-C6-Alkylenkette;
paragraphs.en: L    an alkylene chain C1-C6 which is optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals R2;
paragraphs.notes: The 2 of R2 is a superscript; the 1 and 6 of C1-C6 are subscripts.

paragraphs.zh: Y    eine divalente Einheit aus der Gruppe O, S, N-H, N-Alkyl, CHR7 und C(R7)2;
paragraphs.en: Y    a divalent unit from the group consisting of O, S, N-H, N-alkyl, CHR7 and C(R7)2;
paragraphs.notes: The 7 of each R7 is a superscript and the trailing 2 of C(R7)2 is a subscript.

paragraphs.zh: Z    . eine direkte Bindung, eine divalente Einheit aus der Gruppe O, S, SO, SO2, N-H, N-Alkyl, CHR7 oder C(R7)2;
paragraphs.en: Z    . a direct bond, a divalent unit from the group consisting of O, S, SO, SO2, N-H, N-alkyl, CHR7 or C(R7)2;
paragraphs.notes: A stray dot-like mark is printed between 'Z' and 'eine'; it is transcribed as '.' because it is clearly inked rather than dirt, but it carries no meaning. The 2 of SO2 and the trailing 2 of C(R7)2 are subscripts; the 7 of each R7 is a superscript.
The missing space after the first comma ('0,1,') is as printed. The definition list ends with a comma, so it continues on the next printed page.
